# Find a duplicate vendor payment before you write it off.

> Free private CSV tool for small businesses and bookkeepers to find duplicate or double vendor payments in an accounts-payable export before requesting a refund.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
